A man believes he has uncovered evidence of time travel in a long-forgotten photograph of his grandfather

07:00, 07 Sep 2026

One bloke reckons he's stumbled upon evidence of time travel in an old photograph of his grandad, claiming that the pensioner is clutching what appears to be an iPhone.

‌

He shared a TikTok featuring a snapshot of his grandfather.

‌

Intriguingly, he suggests in the image that his forebear might have been a time traveller, as he's holding an object that they insist bears an uncanny resemblance to a contemporary smartphone.

‌

The video, posted by user Jimmy The Filmmaker, has already amassed 16,000 likes.

‌

In the clip, he says: "This is a picture of my grandpa George, during World War II. My brother and I were looking at it and we thought, was grandpa a time traveller?

"Because we're pretty sure that's an iPhone," they added, zooming in on the object held in his left hand.

Jimmy joins a long line of social media users purporting to have unearthed evidence of time travel.

Article continues below

However, other viewers were quick to point out the holes in his unproven theory, offering far more likely explanations.

One spectator suggested it was probably a mirror used for signalling morse code or for shaving.

The latter seems particularly plausible given the man in the photo, whom they claim is their relative and refer to as "Papa George", has a towel slung over his shoulder and is holding a can of water.
